verdict.rationale: Supabase docs claim self-hosting as an option for users needing 'full control over your data' or compliance requirements, which implies data residency control by running your own infrastructure (supabase-docs-3/29). However, the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of region selection for hosted/managed Supabase projects (e.g., a region picker at project creation), which is the more common AI-native use case. Missing for 10: explicit hosted-plan region selection docs, confirmation of available regions, and independent verification of residency guarantees.
